decisions: 2J-010 is integrated at merge commit 0b51c77dc2fd8b7f0e1bc7eceff9e2889a041513; approved PR head was 2f209a5809d1987e772306e79632e24c70fbf5fd.
The Clients 360 slice stores only basic contact/profile data and its own create/archive history.
Training, Bunker, progress and health remain in their existing source; connected cross-module records are not duplicated.
Client PII routes deny by default and require a server-resolved authorization context; caller headers are not trusted.
clients.manage is Admin-only until write grants for other roles are explicitly decided.
Production identity/session integration and authorization context remain unconfigured, so production routes fail closed.
risks: Independent review and PostgreSQL CI are pending for this implementation head.
Trainer client read scope and permission mapping for future sensitive modules require independent verification against product decisions.
Calendar/Reservations PR #8 must wait until 2J-020 is integrated.
followups: Run full hosted CI and PostgreSQL tests on this head.
Request independent Claude backend/security review and Antigravity/Gemini UX review.
Keep PR #8 blocked from implementation integration until 2J-020 merges.
Do not activate LIVE providers or add real client data.
summary: First real Clients 360 slice adds PostgreSQL-backed client list/search, profile, basic-data create/archive and own-module history. Other profile tabs are honest source-linked placeholders. All PII routes fail closed without server authorization.
reviewer_instructions: Review this exact PR head independently; do not treat author-side checks as independent approval.
Verify PII is never returned without server-side clients.read and caller-supplied role headers do not authorize.
Confirm no training, Bunker, Health, payment or scheduling data is duplicated or exposed by these placeholders.
